title: Grammar Walk
subtitle: what+명사 · how+형용사 대화 (p. 90–91)
introKo: Section A 2문항(대화 짝 맞추기 7+3쌍), Section B 2문항(대화 짝 맞추기 7+3쌍)입니다.

sections.title: Section A
sections.instructionKo: 다음 대화의 뜻을 생각하며 따라 써 보세요. 질문(A)과 대답(B)을 짝지어 연결하세요.

sections.title: Section B
sections.instructionKo: 다음 대화의 뜻을 생각하며 따라 써 보세요. 질문(A)과 대답(B)을 짝지어 연결하세요.

items.sectionInstructionKo: 다음 대화의 뜻을 생각하며 따라 써 보세요. 질문(A)과 대답(B)을 짝지어 연결하세요.
items.label: A1

pairs.left: 1. A: What time is it now?
2. A: What time is it now?
3. A: What time is it?
4. A: What day is it today?
5. A: What day is it today?
6. A: What day is it today?
7. A: What color is this?

accept: 1. A: What time is it now?|B: It's one o'clock.
2. A: What time is it now?|B: It's nine o'clock.
3. A: What time is it?|B: It's three o'clock.
4. A: What day is it today?|B: It's Tuesday.
5. A: What day is it today?|B: It's Thursday.
6. A: What day is it today?|B: It's Friday.
7. A: What color is this?|B: It's black.

items.sectionInstructionKo: 다음 대화의 뜻을 생각하며 따라 써 보세요. 질문(A)과 대답(B)을 짝지어 연결하세요.
items.label: A2

pairs.left: 8. A: What color is the cap?
9. A: What color are your boots?
10. A: What color is it?

accept: 8. A: What color is the cap?|B: It's yellow.
9. A: What color are your boots?|B: They're blue.
10. A: What color is it?|B: It's pink.

items.sectionInstructionKo: 다음 대화의 뜻을 생각하며 따라 써 보세요. 질문(A)과 대답(B)을 짝지어 연결하세요.
items.label: B1

pairs.left: 1. A: How old is he?
2. A: How old are they?
3. A: How old is your sister?
4. A: How much is the pen?
5. A: How much is it?
6. A: How much are they?
7. A: How many dogs do you have?

accept: 1. A: How old is he?|B: Eight years old.
2. A: How old are they?|B: Four years old.
3. A: How old is your sister?|B: Ten years old.
4. A: How much is the pen?|B: Six hundred won.
5. A: How much is it?|B: One hundred won.
6. A: How much are they?|B: Two thousand won.
7. A: How many dogs do you have?|B: Two.

items.sectionInstructionKo: 다음 대화의 뜻을 생각하며 따라 써 보세요. 질문(A)과 대답(B)을 짝지어 연결하세요.
items.label: B2

pairs.left: 8. A: How many flowers does Bill have?
9. A: How many balls does he have?
10. A: How many eggs do I have?

accept: 8. A: How many flowers does Bill have?|B: Four.
9. A: How many balls does he have?|B: Three.
10. A: How many eggs do I have?|B: Twenty.
